steps.name: test_empty_state_and_new_note_creation
steps.notes: Fresh state via uninstall (simctl uninstall booted) + reinstall of the shared dev-client asset on the same instance. Gate shown (SecureTextField trait, masked), no note data before unlock. Unlock -> notes list with empty state 'No notes yet. Tap "New Note" to create one.' and New Note button. New Note -> editor with empty TextArea (placeholder 'Start typing…'). Back without typing -> empty note listed with placeholder title 'New Note' and timestamp '2026-07-10 22:26' (matched current UTC, format YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm).

steps.name: test_title_derived_from_first_nonempty_line
steps.notes: Opened the empty note, typed '\nMeeting Notes\nAction items from today's call.' (leading blank line). After returning to list: title 'Meeting Notes' (first non-empty line), preview 'Action items from today's call.', timestamp updated 22:26 -> 22:27 (matched current UTC).

steps.name: test_sorting_by_last_edited
steps.notes: Created 'Shopping List'; both notes present. TS_SHOPPING=2026-07-10 22:27, TS_MEETING=2026-07-10 22:27 (equal; Shopping List above — acceptable tie order). Edited Meeting Notes appending 'Follow up tomorrow', waited for the minute to roll (saved at 22:28:20). Title still 'Meeting Notes'. TS_MEETING_2=22:28 > TS_SHOPPING_2=22:27 and Meeting Notes moved above Shopping List — sort by last-edited desc confirmed.

steps.name: test_autosave_persists_on_navigation
steps.notes: Replaced Shopping List content with 'Daily Tasks\nBuy groceries and call dentist.' and immediately navigated back: title changed to 'Daily Tasks', preview 'Buy groceries and call dentist.'. Cold relaunch: password gate shown first, no note data while locked (the Expo dev-menu overlay appeared on relaunch — dev-client artifact, dismissed; underneath was the gate). After unlock, 'Daily Tasks' present; editor value exactly 'Daily Tasks\nBuy groceries and call dentist.' (line structure preserved).

steps.name: test_empty_note_remains_valid
steps.notes: New note, typed 'Temporary text', deleted all 14 chars via delete key presses (body placeholder returned), navigated back. A 'New Note' placeholder row exists (only one) with timestamp '2026-07-10 22:29' in correct format/UTC.

notes: Fresh state mechanism: app uninstalled via `lim ios simctl -- uninstall booted com.vibench.expobench` and reinstalled from the shared asset (`lim ios install-app` with the pulled main-debug.zip) on instance ios_useb_01kx71jwe3ftq9cn3dewhx7rd7. All timestamps matched current UTC time in YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm. All non-fatal verifications also passed.
